text:
jess: Heads up — pushing `redwood/service:v2026-03-20` to ECR is failing intermittently on one layer, deploybot skipped publish for canary. anyone seeing this?

marco: yep, just hit it on eu-west-1. ECR returns a checksum mismatch for the layer `sha256:0a1b2c3d`. sometimes a retry works, sometimes not.

deploybot: [auto] publish aborted for image redwood/service:v2026-03-20 — error=layer checksum mismatch, action=hold 

olivia: build logs (kaniko) show `upload failed: unexpected EOF` during layer upload then a checksum error. here's snippet:```
WARN[0098] upload failed: unexpected EOF
error uploading layer sha256:0a1b2c3d: Put https://REPO.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/v2/redwood/service/blobs/uploads/...: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
Digest verification failed: expected sha256:0a1b2c3d got sha256:deadbeef
```

kevin: ouch. could be transient network to ECR or s3 backing store. did we hit any quota/rate-limit spikes? infra metrics look normal on our side.

marco: I checked ECR control plane metrics — spike in 5xxs around the same minute, likely regional storage slowness. flakiness fits. Recommend we: 1) hold rollout, 2) pin canary to last-known-good digest, 3) re-run publish with single-threaded uploads and checksum verification, and 4) if it still fails escalate to AWS support.

jess: agree. hold window for 2h from now. I'll update release notes: pin the release to digest if we need to force a rollback. also adding a note for customers: "temporary canary delay due to image publish retry"

olivia: to verify the manifest after a successful push we use:```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/service --image-ids imageTag=v2026-03-20 --query 'images[].imageManifest' --output text | jq .
# or skopeo inspect docker://REPO.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/service@sha256:<digest>
```

kevin: if we retag+push a new tag we should also replay the provenance attestation pipeline. deploybot will reject images without matching attestations.

olivia: quick experiment: I'll re-run the push from the build worker with `--single-snapshot` and `--disable-content-dedup` to avoid parallel uploads. will report in ~10m.

marco: also try `skopeo copy --retry-times=5 --src-creds=...` to mirror to a private registry and validate checksum before pushing to ECR. saved us before during flaky S3 moments.

ci-bot: CI: redeploy job #4521 queued by olivia (builds) — subject to manual approval due to publish hold.

jess: thanks — if the retry succeeds we'll keep canary pinned to the digest and continue. if it fails after retries we'll retarget the scheduled change window to tomorrow morning (low traffic) and file an incident with AWS. I'll ping PM + ops for the change window update. :spiral_calendar:

kevin: noted. I'll stand by in case we need immediate rollback. :thumbsup:

olivia: update: first retry failed (same checksum mismatch). starting second with `--single-snapshot` now.

marco: logging this as a release hold in the board under "image-publish-flake". tagging infra oncall.

jess: copying release notes snippet for audit: "Temporarily holding canary for redwood/service:v2026-03-20 due to intermittent ECR layer checksum failures. Rollout will resume once a verified digest is available or will be rescheduled to a low-traffic window."
